_readme: Customer reviews for reviews.html. Edit this file, commit, push; node build.js renders it into the page.
Only add reviews the customer actually wrote, with their permission to publish. Never write or edit one for them.
Each review: author (required), rating 1-5 (required), text (required), date as YYYY-MM-DD (required),
source (optional: Google, Facebook, Direct...), sourceUrl (optional link to the original),
product (optional, e.g. 'Mahindra 1626 HST'), reply (optional dealership response), publish (set false to hide).
reviews.html stays noindex and out of the sitemap until at least one review is published here.

reviews.author: Amy Dubois
reviews.text: Friendly and knowledgeable staff. They didn't waste my time. Gave me the quote and information I asked for.

reviews.author: Brian Holes
reviews.text: Purchased a Bad Boy tractor package last month and their customs support team was OUTSTANDING! The service and equipment were well worth the drive from TN to make this purchase.

reviews.author: Keith Grisco
reviews.text: Great place with good people. I was shopping for a tractor and they were very helpful. I did not buy one from them because I found a very nice one that was just a few years old from an individual, but I would definitely buy one from these guys and use them for service.
